Analytical_Objective: Verify mathematical footing of 24-month balance sheets and classify accounts into transaction buckets
Required_Source_Documents: Monthly trial balances audited balance sheets general ledger detail
Step_by_Step_Execution: Extract 24 consecutive month-end balance sheets verify Assets = Liab + Equity classify into NWC Debt Cash Excluded
Forensic_Red_Flags: Unreconciled balancing plugs out-of-period adjustments misclassified financing accounts
Mathematical_Formulas: Assets = Liabilities + Equity; Operating NWC = Oper Current Assets - Oper Current Liab
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Baseline verification; establishes clean boundary for all subsequent schedules
Double_Counting_Firewall: Prevents unclassified balance sheet leakage into purchase price

Analytical_Objective: Identify trade payables aging beyond normal commercial terms to prevent post-close cash drain
Required_Source_Documents: AP subledger aging reports vendor master files master supplier agreements
Step_by_Step_Execution: Stratify AP aging into 0-30 31-60 61-90 and 90+ days compare to contractual vendor payment terms
Forensic_Red_Flags: Spike in 60+ and 90+ day AP prior to transaction; vendor credit holds
Mathematical_Formulas: Stretched AP = Sum(AP over contractual terms) - Normal historical baseline aged AP
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Reclassified from NWC to Debt-Like Item (dollar-for-dollar purchase price deduction)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Must be removed from NWC liabilities to avoid penalizing seller twice

Analytical_Objective: Test whether allowance for doubtful accounts was suppressed to inflate working capital
Required_Source_Documents: AR aging subledgers bad debt write-off logs customer bankruptcy notices
Step_by_Step_Execution: Analyze historical bad debt loss rates compare aging buckets to reserve percentages test specific delinquent accounts
Forensic_Red_Flags: Reserve percentage declines while 90+ day overdue AR increases; unreserved bankrupt accounts
Mathematical_Formulas: Required Reserve = Sum(Aging Bucket Balance * Historical Default Rate %)
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: NWC Normalizing Adjustment (increases reserve decreases NWC)
Double_Counting_Firewall: If bad debt expense was rejected in EBITDA (WS05) balance sheet reserve must be normalized

Analytical_Objective: Identify slow-moving and dead stock lacking adequate reserves to establish true realizable value
Required_Source_Documents: Inventory aging schedules SKU movement reports scrap logs count sheets
Step_by_Step_Execution: Group inventory by SKU evaluate trailing 12-month unit usage calculate months of supply on hand
Forensic_Red_Flags: High inventory balance with zero sales in trailing 12 months; scrap logged on shop floor but not in GL
Mathematical_Formulas: Excess Reserve = Sum(SKU Value with >12 Months of Supply * Obsolescence Factor %)
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: NWC Normalizing Adjustment (reduces inventory value in NWC)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Ensures inventory write-down is reflected in NWC peg without double-counting in COGS

Analytical_Objective: Establish defensible operating NWC benchmark for closing purchase price true-up
Required_Source_Documents: Monthly 24-month normalized NWC model run-rate revenue forecasts
Step_by_Step_Execution: Calculate 12-month average 6-month average seasonal peg and percentage-of-revenue peg evaluate seasonality
Forensic_Red_Flags: Seller pushing for historical low trough peg to generate unearned post-close cash true-up
column13: Target Peg Benchmark (Settled via Closing Statement post-close true-up)
column14: Baseline for purchase price true-up; distinct from debt-like deductions

Analytical_Objective: Audit outstanding principal balances and accrued interest on all legal credit facilities
Required_Source_Documents: Credit agreements bank statements payoff letters per diem interest schedules
Step_by_Step_Execution: Obtain formal bank payoff letters verify principal interest prepayment penalties and UCC lien releases
Forensic_Red_Flags: Undisclosed promissory notes per diem interest omitted unreleased liens on assets
Mathematical_Formulas: Funded Debt = Principal + Accrued Interest + Prepayment Penalties
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Funded Debt Deduction (dollar-for-dollar purchase price deduction)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Subtracted directly from Enterprise Value in EV-to-Equity bridge

Analytical_Objective: Isolate change-of-control bonuses success fees and legal costs triggered by transaction
Required_Source_Documents: Employment agreements transaction bonus plans advisory engagement letters
Step_by_Step_Execution: Inspect board minutes and bonus plans calculate employer payroll taxes verify payment timing at closing
Forensic_Red_Flags: Transaction bonuses buried inside general operating payroll accruals
Mathematical_Formulas: Total Deal Bonus = Gross Bonuses + Employer FICA/Medicare Taxes + Advisory Fees
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Debt-Like Item (deducted from purchase price at closing)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Permissible add-back in EBITDA (WS05) ONLY if deducted as Debt-Like Item at close

Analytical_Objective: Identify unremitted sales tax liabilities resulting from Wayfair economic nexus thresholds
Required_Source_Documents: Sales registers state tax returns nexus surveys exemption certificates
Step_by_Step_Execution: Evaluate out-of-state sales volume by state inspect customer resale exemption certificates quantify exposure
Forensic_Red_Flags: High sales into states without tax registration; missing customer exemption certificates
Mathematical_Formulas: Tax Exposure = Taxable Sales * State Tax Rate % + Estimated Penalties & Interest
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Debt-Like Item (deducted from purchase price or held in special tax indemnity escrow)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Excluded from operational NWC to prevent distorting ongoing commercial working capital

Analytical_Objective: Quantify unaccrued employee paid time off and earned vacation obligations
Required_Source_Documents: HR employee census PTO policy handbook vacation tracking logs
Step_by_Step_Execution: Multiply accrued unused vacation hours by employee hourly wage rates add statutory employer payroll tax
Forensic_Red_Flags: PTO tracked informally on spreadsheets without matching general ledger accrual
Mathematical_Formulas: Unfunded PTO = Sum(Unused Hours * Loaded Hourly Compensation Rate)
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Debt-Like Item (deducted from purchase price) or NWC Normalizing Adjustment
Double_Counting_Firewall: Must be classified consistently between Target Peg and Closing Balance Sheet

Analytical_Objective: Quantify post-close obligation to fulfill prepaid contracts without future cash collection
Required_Source_Documents: Customer contracts billing schedules deferred revenue subledgers fulfillment cost models
Step_by_Step_Execution: Calculate direct cost to fulfill post-closing performance obligations plus normal operating profit margin
Forensic_Red_Flags: Upfront multi-year cash collections consumed by seller leaving buyer with uncompensated obligations
Mathematical_Formulas: ASC 805 Haircut = Recorded Deferred Revenue - (Fulfillment Cost + Normal Margin)
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Debt-Like Item (deducted from purchase price) or Working Capital Liability
Double_Counting_Firewall: Debt-like treatment protects buyer cash; NWC treatment requires inclusion in Target Peg

Analytical_Objective: Identify unperformed capital repairs and maintenance backlog resulting from pre-sale cash hoarding
Required_Source_Documents: Equipment service logs machinery inspection reports engineering condition audits
Step_by_Step_Execution: Engage independent machinery appraisers inspect maintenance logs identify overdue overhauls
Forensic_Red_Flags: Preventative maintenance halted 12 months prior to sale; critical machines running on deferred status
Mathematical_Formulas: CapEx Deficit = Estimated Cost of Required Immediate Machinery Overhauls
Double_Counting_Firewall: Must not double-count with P&L repair expenses normalized in WS05 (ADJ-005)

Analytical_Objective: Distinguish unrestricted operating cash from restricted trapped or collateralized cash
Required_Source_Documents: Bank statements lockbox reconciliations letter of credit agreements escrow notices
Step_by_Step_Execution: Inspect bank accounts identify cash pledged for letters of credit utility deposits or foreign transfer blocks
Forensic_Red_Flags: Pledging cash as collateral for standby letters of credit while presenting 100% as unrestricted cash
Mathematical_Formulas: Unrestricted Cash = Total Cash on Hand - Restricted Cash - Minimum Operating Cash Buffer
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Cash Addition to Purchase Price (Unrestricted cash added to equity value)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Trapped cash is excluded from cash addition; minimum operating cash evaluated in peg

Analytical_Objective: Calculate operational days metrics using count-back exhaustion to eliminate seasonal distortion
Balance_Sheet_Line_Items: Monthly Sales COGS AR AP Inventory
Required_Source_Documents: Monthly sales ledgers purchasing registers inventory balances
Step_by_Step_Execution: Count back daily/monthly revenue until cumulative sales equal ending AR; repeat for inventory and AP
Forensic_Red_Flags: Standard 365-day formulas distorting operational rhythms in highly seasonal businesses
Mathematical_Formulas: DSO = Exhaustion Days; DIO = Exhaustion Days; DPO = Exhaustion Days; CCC = DSO + DIO - DPO
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Operational Efficiency Diagnostic (guides target peg and intra-month risk assessment)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Analytical metric informing peg setting; no direct balance sheet journal entry

Analytical_Objective: Measure cash and working capital swings within calendar months to prevent month-end distortion
Balance_Sheet_Line_Items: Daily Cash Balances Credit Line Borr.
Required_Source_Documents: Daily bank cash ledgers revolving credit borrowing logs mid-month check runs
Step_by_Step_Execution: Plot daily cash and credit line balances identify peak working capital requirement vs month-end snapshot
Forensic_Red_Flags: Month-end cash window dressing (gathering collections and halting payments before month-end)
Mathematical_Formulas: Intra-Month Peak Gap = Peak Working Capital Requirement - Month-End Average NWC
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Informs Minimum Operating Cash Buffer and Target Peg Buffer (Collar)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Protects buyer from inheriting intra-month liquidity deficits

Analytical_Objective: Audit non-bank debt owed to founders and calculate unaccrued compound interest
Required_Source_Documents: Promissory notes loan agreements interest payment receipts tax returns
Step_by_Step_Execution: Inspect note terms recalculate compounding interest verify subordination terms to senior bank debt
Forensic_Red_Flags: Founders presenting face value of note without compounding unpaid historical interest
Mathematical_Formulas: Total Shareholder Debt = Note Principal + Accrued Unpaid Interest to Closing Date
Transaction_Settlement_Mechanism: Funded Debt Deduction (dollar-for-dollar purchase price deduction)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Settled out of seller closing proceeds; unaccrued interest added to debt payoff

Analytical_Objective: Draft enforceable accounting principles and true-up dispute protocols for SPA
Required_Source_Documents: Model Stock Purchase Agreement (ABA) target working capital principles schedule
Step_by_Step_Execution: Draft specific inclusion/exclusion schedule define consistency hierarchy establish 90-day true-up rules
Forensic_Red_Flags: Vague SPA language referencing 'GAAP consistently applied' leading to post-close arbitration
Mathematical_Formulas: True-Up Cash Adjustment = Closing Delivered NWC - Target Working Capital Peg
Double_Counting_Firewall: Definitive contract mechanism governing post-close cash true-up between buyer and seller
